overview: The Medford City Council met to discuss municipal infrastructure, utility paving oversight, neighborhood blasting impacts, and facility repairs. The Council also granted final approval to a revised city redistricting map.

items.title: Masonry Dust Policy Inquiry
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the Health Department and Building Department meet to discuss policy guidance regarding public safety concerns over outdoor dry-cutting masonry dust.

items.title: Eversource Paving and Timeline Update
items.summary: Approved as amended resolutions requesting timeline updates and addressing concerns over paving quality on Mystic Avenue and South Street with city engineering and DPW staff.

items.title: Winthrop Street Blasting Update
items.summary: Approved as amended resolutions requesting a Committee of the Whole meeting and neighborhood updates regarding ongoing ledge blasting for the construction project at 541-551 Winthrop Street.

items.title: Final Approval of City Redistricting Map A
items.summary: Approved Map A and its associated legal boundary descriptions for the city's redistricting plan on a roll call vote following a suspension of the rules.

items.title: Report Request on DPW Street Repair and Injury Claims
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the administration and DPW to report on street repair plans and detail personal injury and property damage claims from potholes over the past year.

items.title: Inquiry on Encore Casino Community Funds
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an update on plans to reconvene the Medford Community Fund committee to disburse $250,000 in accumulated Encore Casino grant funds.

items.title: Transition Plan for Municipal Parking Program
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution seeking a report and Committee of the Whole meeting on the administration's plan to transition parking enforcement in-house and solicit community input.

items.title: Hormel Stadium Condition and Improvement Plan
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution asking the administration for a report and Committee of the Whole meeting regarding repair needs and long-term plans for Hormel Stadium.

items.title: Resurfacing Plan for Field of Dreams
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution requesting a report on plans to replace aging turf at Medford High School's Field of Dreams and an update on its debt service schedule.

items.title: Hot Water Maintenance at High School Swimming Pool
items.summary: Approved as amended a resolution requesting a school administration report and a Board of Health inspection concerning the lack of hot water in the high school pool showers.

items.title: Condolences and Moments of Silence
items.summary: Approved resolutions extending condolences to the family of educator Jane McDevitt and observing a moment of silence for retired deputy police officer William "Billy" Butts.
